about: Keys no Minecraft version reads that check_data_formats lets pass anyway, because leaving them in changes nothing in game. Keep this short: every entry needs the reason it is harmless. A key the game ignores while the author meant it to do something (an `nbt` on a loot entry, `levels` on enchant_randomly) does not belong here.

keys.reason: enchant_with_levels has never read `only_compatible` and only ever picks enchantments that fit the item, which is what `"only_compatible": true` asks for (MBS 1.20 base_loot_towers.json)
